runtime: C++20, SDL3, bgfx Metal, Infinity Hyperion renderer
packaged_app_test: passed: signed app crossed Oylanhai to Ziksa with four cargo units, physically docked and bought four iron in a separate run, and rendered Tidal Blue with the ship rolled
integration_tests: passed: immutable destination, two-hop route, final-world handoff, pause/resume, route save/restore, cockpit selection, world search, frame-invariant position, map picking, anchored zoom
economy_integration_tests: passed: physical docking access, conserved transactions, stock and cargo limits, sealed charter, real berth departure and wormhole haul, fuel progress, save validation, construction, vault storage, farms and guards, finite deposits, restoration, culture, galleries, offline settlement, deadlines and UI bounds
native_restart_result: same 1976958 cents, 4 cargo units and actual station berth after restoring atomic session
economy_limits: Offline public-rule implementation with local balance; full server economy not reproduced. See ECONOMY.md.
graphics_style: Charred Glass, Verdant Fog, Tidal Blue and Acid Etch regional looks with depth-aware camera optics
graphics_scope: warp streaks and soft destination fade
shader_embedding: Project-local checked-in shaders, source/binary SHA-256 validated at CMake configuration
colour_reference: Two user-supplied wildfire photographs, used for the palette only
highlight_response: Peak-aware saturation brightness and retained HDR heat highlights; source silhouettes stay near black
reflection_model: Current-frame opaque colour/depth plus RGBA16F authored view normals and roughness; 28 ray steps and five refinements; edge fade and directional environment fallback
reflection_limits: Only visible geometry can appear in screen-space reflections; off-screen rays use the environment. Glass interiors are optical parallax, not newly simulated rooms.
space_glass: Celestial-direction optical sheets with broad reflective faces, nested caustics, live-background refraction and second-surface images; depth masked and composited before the HUD

lens_verification.method: Matching native frames and saved berth, lens on/off. World RGB difference, identical title HUD pixels, deep-shadow and yellow-highlight coverage. Full images inspected visually.
lens_verification.aperture: 48-tap, eight-blade iris, edge cat-eye compression, isolated highlight footprint compensation
lens_verification.focus: Central five-depth cross; opaque-depth silhouette rejection; five-pixel geometric blur cap
lens_verification.pipeline: Opaque HDR + atmosphere + SSR + glass-space refraction -> optical HDR -> highlight seed -> aperture bokeh -> single display transform + halation/flare -> physical cockpit -> HUD
lens_verification.limits: Screen-space camera approximation; transparent surfaces use opaque depth; no temporal autofocus history; no simulated lens geometry.

warp_visuals: Ember speed streaks and smooth destination fade; no petalled fronts, scalloped ribs, or exit ring.

regional_looks.assignment: Stable by occupied 20 x 20 sector region
regional_looks.acid_example: Eudaya (6,4), five wormhole hops from Oylanhai
regional_looks.tested_route: Iasaugs, Tidal Blue, to Oergoi, Acid Etch
regional_looks.acid_model: Material-space pitting, rough slate, raspberry oxidation and sulphur-yellow mineral crust with separate pink and yellow grading curves
regional_looks.tidal_model: Three curved celestial currents with filtered swells, broken foam, reflected glints and open gaps. The sky shader anchors the currents to the celestial field.

acid_palette_verification.result: Each matching scene has more pink and yellow and less orange than 0.8.0. Visual inspection confirmed slate surfaces and sulphur mineral deposits.

tidal_current_verification.result: World-aligned swells and open starfield in both pitch directions. The same swells align after rotating the inverted image back 180 degrees.

structure_lighting_verification.model: Authored structure finishes and fixture colours with regional diffuse light, reflected highlights and distance haze. The normal buffer identifies built surfaces so their finish survives the final display grade.
